_about: Grid electricity prices the app shows in the Explorer lens and uses to compare sites. Only published figures, each with its source; where a regulator publishes a time-of-use structure but the rate table could not be read, the structure is given and the rate is left for the user's bill. No night discount exists in Nigeria.

NG.name: Nigeria
NG.label: NERC Band A (≥ 20 h a day)
NG.source: NERC Multi-Year Tariff Order — Band A ₦209.50/kWh (Daily Trust, NERC order)
NG.night_note: Flat tariff: the price is the same at night. Night charging in Nigeria is about when the feeder is live, not about price.

Enugu.label: EERC Band A (Enugu State market)
Enugu.source: Enugu State Electricity Regulatory Commission order EERC/2025/003 — Band A ₦160/kWh (Nairametrics, Enugu State Government)

KE.name: Kenya
KE.label: Kenya Power CI1 — energy charge from your bill
KE.source: EPRA time-of-use rule: 50 % discount on the energy charge in off-peak hours (Kenyans.co.ke / EPRA); the 2018 KPLC schedule listed CI1 at KSh 12.00 and KSh 6.00 off-peak — confirm the current rate on the bill

tou_rule.text: Off-peak 22:00–06:00 on weekdays, 14:00–08:00 Saturdays, all day Sundays and public holidays: 50 % off the energy charge

KE.night_note: Night is cheaper: a 50 % discount on the energy charge in the off-peak hours — charging batteries overnight makes financial sense here.

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.label: Eskom Megaflex — rate from your bill
ZA.source: Eskom Schedule of Standard Prices (Megaflex: seasonal and time-of-use energy charges; peak-to-off-peak ratio reduced to 6:1; evening peak 3 h, morning peak 2 h)

tou_rule.text: Three periods: peak (morning 2 h, evening 3 h), standard, off-peak overnight; peak costs about six times off-peak

ZA.night_note: Night is much cheaper (off-peak): peak is about six times the off-peak energy charge, so overnight charging is the normal strategy.

GH.name: Ghana
GH.label: PURC non-residential, 301+ kWh
GH.source: PURC tariff order effective 1 April 2026 — non-residential 301+ kWh 216.49 pesewas/kWh (GNA, AllAfrica)
